identification.description: Evergreen tree with leathery leaves and conspicuous flowers; the medicinal drug commonly consists of the dried stamens, which are slender and yellowish.

shlokas:
नागपुष्पं नागकेशरं केशरं हेमपुष्पकम् ।
नागकेशरं कषायं तिक्तं लघूष्णं कफापहम् ।
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Karpuradi Varga; supplied 71–73 requires edition-specific verification.

identification.description: Aromatic evergreen tree; leaves are lanceolate and characteristically show three prominent longitudinal veins from the base.

shlokas:
तेजपत्रं तु सुगन्धि स्यात् कटु तिक्तं च दीपकम् ।
कफवातहरं हृद्यं मुखशोधि च कथ्यते ॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Karpuradi Varga; supplied 66–67 requires edition-specific verification.

identification.description: Dried unopened flower buds with a characteristic nail-like shape, dark reddish-brown colour and strong aromatic pungency.

shlokas:
लवङ्गं देवकुसुमं श्रीसंज्ञं श्रीप्रसूनकम् ।
लवङ्गं कटुकं तिक्तं तीक्ष्णं चक्षुष्यं शीतलम् ॥

identification.description: Hard aromatic seed with a marbled or ruminate interior, enclosed by the red aril (mace).

shlokas:
जातीफलं कटु तिक्तं तीक्ष्णोष्णं रोचनं लघु ।
जातीफलं कफवातघ्नं ग्राही दीपकमुच्यते ॥

identification.description: Small globose dried fruits with a characteristic short stalk, giving the common name tailed pepper; strongly aromatic and pungent.

shlokas:
कङ्कोलकं कटु तिक्तं तीक्ष्णोष्णं कफवातजित् ।
सुगन्धि हृद्यं रुचिकृत् मुखदौर्गन्ध्यनाशनम् ॥
